connections.ownAddress.help.old: For a proxy with one path per provider: this model can use another path on the same server, such as /proxy/openai beside /proxy/google-ai. It still uses the Connection's key.
connections.ownAddress.help.new: For a proxy with one path per provider: this model can use another path on the same server, such as /proxy/openai beside /proxy/google-ai. Type only the path; it follows the server when its address changes. It still uses the Connection's key.

connections.ownAddress.hint.old: Leave it empty to use the Connection's address ({{address}}). Only addresses on the same server work, because this model uses the Connection's key.
connections.ownAddress.hint.new: Leave it empty to use the Connection's address ({{address}}). Type a path such as /proxy/zai, or a full address on the same server; another server won't work, because this model uses the Connection's key.

ui.chat.chatsettingsdrawer.illustratorDe.new: Pick a Decision model under Connections > Defaults to have it check every reply for a new place, new weather or a new time of day.
